_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Zero of 65 windows moved ±2+ points and the analyst's own 17.6% direction accuracy in chop confirms this is a genuine coil where forced directional calls bleed out, making HOLD the skilled graded call.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst calls HOLD into Complacency with medium conviction; narrative implies directional upside (LONG bias) into Hope/Optimism with 0.77 confidence; the split is real and unresolved
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows recover above 30 AND BTC dominance fades below 35 with funding staying tame — signals risk-on rotation lifting toward Disbelief
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX spikes above 75 with DXY breaking 103 and funding flipping negative — forces risk-off leg down toward Panic, or ETF flows stay at zero while gold strength pushes 85+ confirming capital flight to safety
